slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from the manufactured toys, or is there a different objective such as minimizing resource usage or meeting a specific production target?
slot_scores.rationale: Agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: Agent never inquired about any relationship tying the number of boats to the number of trains; the related boat/airplane dependency question does not cover this slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains, so no boat <= train restriction was included.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boat-train relationship, so the omission of this constraint in the final model was unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0 slots (H1 objective) were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the only unresolved slot is the P2 boat-train constraint, which does not block a well-posed model.

summary: The agent recovered the P0 objective and clarified the truck/train and boat/airplane logical constraints, but never probed the P2 boat-vs-train relationship, silently omitting it before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
